title: Do cystic fibrosis centres with the lowest FEV
abstract: The Epidemiologic Study of Cystic Fibrosis using 1995-1996 and 2003-2005 data found that CF centres with lowest FEV Analysing data for 2013 and 2014 separately, 28 adult CF centres were ranked according to median % age-adjusted FEV Centres in the 'upper quarter' and 'middle half' used significantly more IV antibiotics compared to centres in the 'lower quarter' (van Elteren test P-value<0.001). Regression analyses showed that people with CF attending centres in the 'upper quarter' or 'middle half' are 30-50% more likely to receive at least one IV course per year compared to people attending centres in the 'lower quarter'.
